Which description of Brownian motion is correct?
A
random movement of particles due to bombardment by larger particles
B
random movement of particles due to bombardment by smaller particles
C
random movement of particles from a high concentration to a low concentration
D
random movement of particles from a low concentration to a high concentration

options.label: A
options.text: random movement of particles due to bombardment by larger particles

options.label: B
options.text: random movement of particles due to bombardment by smaller particles

options.label: C
options.text: random movement of particles from a high concentration to a low concentration

options.label: D
options.text: random movement of particles from a low concentration to a high concentration
